                        p.title Dear Client,
                        p.text We are contacting you regarding your application to become an Elective Professional Client.
                        p.text On further investigation we noticed that we need some additional documentation to ensure that you have the appropriate conditions to remain an Elective Professional Client:
                        p.text.list Supporting evidence of trades for the last 4 quarters of over 150 EUR per trade for at least 10 trades per quarter. You can provide us with the trading history from other trading accounts you have showing the logo of the company, your name, trading amount, type and date, and leverage (if applicable)
                        p.text.list.pb20 Supporting evidence of your financial portfolio (incl. cash and financial instruments) showing an amount exceeding 500.000 EUR. This evidence can be a bank statement which is stamped by your bank and shows your balance or any other relevant evidence showing the amount (e.g. real estate)
                        p.text
                            strong We can give you a timeframe until Tuesday evening to provide us with the documents. In case we do not receive them after this timeframe we will be forced to turn your status back to retail.
                        p.text
                            strong You can send the documents by attaching them to the answer to this email.
                        p.text We appreciate your cooperation in this matter and remain at your disposal for any questions.
                        p.text Kind regards,
                            br
                            | IQ Option Team
